The Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974 (ERISA) exempts "church plan[s]" from its otherwise-comprehensive regulation of employee benefit plans. 88 Stat. 840, as amended, *165

Justice SOTOMAYOR, concurring.
The Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974 (ERISA) protects employees by ensuring " 'that if a worker has been promised a defined pension benefit upon retirement-and if he has fulfilled whatever conditions are required to obtain a vested benefit-he will actually receive it.'
